description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodFactory class, which is responsible for creating instances of timesheet period classes such as WeeklyTimesheetPeriod. It is part of the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically within the Factory namespace, and provides factory methods for generating timesheet period objects.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating timesheet period instances, such as WeeklyTimesheetPeriod.

methods.name: createTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Dynamically creates and returns an instance of the specified timesheet period class using its class name.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WeeklyTimesheetPeriod instance.
